name: serenity-hunter
description: Supply-chain bottleneck hunter for investment research. Translates market narratives into physical system constraints, maps the full value chain, identifies scarce layers, and ranks public companies by research priority with graded evidence.

governance.rationale: Investment research skill with public methodology claims, scoring scripts that influence financial decisions, and risk-sensitive output.
